people.name: Belshazzar
people.line: The last Emperor of Babylon, son of Nabonidus.

translations.web: Then king Belshazzar was greatly troubled, and his face was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.
translations.bsb: Then King Belshazzar became even more terrified, his face grew even more pale, and his nobles were bewildered.
translations.kjv: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were astonied.
translations.asv: Then was king Belshazzar greatly troubled, and his countenance was changed in him, and his lords were perplexed.
